grandparents_cupboard.reason: Flour, butter, sugar, sultanas, oranges, egg and milk are all plain home baking staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at an ordinary price.

basic_kitchen.reason: A bowl, grater, knife and baking tray are enough, and rubbing in is a beginner's technique.

works.reason: The ratios match a classic egg-enriched scone (350g flour, 85g butter, about 230ml liquid), and 220°C for 12 to 15 minutes will give eight risen scones.

honest_times.reason: Zesting, rubbing in and shaping fit in 15 minutes, and the 15-minute cook matches the bake time in the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and the salt are used, the sultanas match the raisins id, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Oranges are at their best in February, and the zest of two oranges plus juice flavours the whole scone.

plain_voice.reason: The short, clear steps in British English read like a neighbour explaining a bake.

hearty_healthy.reason: A homemade fruit scone with modest sugar, egg and fresh orange is a real-food snack a family would make again.
